scope: The 2 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/x509/v3_authattid.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function. This receipt claims no discharge, no contract and no new reachability finding.
non_claims: This receipt does not discharge any site, and no site may be treated as discharged on its authority.
This receipt does not contract any site; the hazard notes are enumeration notes, not established contracts.
This receipt does not assert reachability; reachability is taken from the enumerated closure and is not re-established here.

boundaries.hazard: Raw OSSL_ISSUER_SERIAL is dereferenced; issuer and issuerUID are forwarded to print helpers, and serial is passed by address to i2a_ASN1_INTEGER.
Raw STACK_OF(OSSL_ISSUER_SERIAL) is iterated and each element passed to i2r_ISSUER_SERIAL; stack and element liveness are caller obligations.
